subject: Deployability & Network Hardening: IaC conformance and anti-pattern scan
messages:
From: Katie Mullins <katie@acme-corp.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Private deploy - quick conformance scan and network notes

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking a look. We just ran an automated conformance scan across our private deployment repo and attached the results. High-level callouts from the vendor scan (attached as iac-conformance-report.pdf):
- Multiple modules using unpinned provider versions (terraform registry)
- Two Terraform modules open SGs with 0.0.0.0/0 egress allowed for legacy reasons
- Helm values with adminService.enabled: true exposing control endpoints on public LB
- Ansible playbook includes a generated service account key under ci/users/ (should be rotated)

Can your infra/security team do a quick triage and call out anything that would block Redwood Private onboarding? We are targeting a tentative handoff to our security team on 2026-06-25.

Attachments: acme-iac-initial-scan.zip (contains scan JSONs), iac-conformance-report.pdf (summary)

Best,
Katie
Katie Mullins
Cloud Security Lead, ACME Corp
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Mullins <katie@acme-corp.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy - quick conformance scan and network notes

Thanks Katie — forwarding to the infra team for a focused triage. I pulled the attached report and did a quick skim. Immediate items that jump out to me (not exhaustive):

- Pin providers & modules: ensure terraform block specifies required_providers and required_version; get modules to release semver tags and update lock files.
- Security groups: close any 0.0.0.0/0 egress/ingress rules; use CIDR allowlists or service endpoints where possible.
- Helm exposure: set adminService.enabled=false by default for private stacks and move control plane endpoints behind an internal-only LB/Ingress.
- Secrets: rotate any checked-in keys; move to KMS + secrets-manager template in Ansible with vault integration.
- CI gating: add tflint/checkov stage and fail on high/critical findings; add plan artifact retention.

Proposed short plan: 1) triage scan results into critical/major/minor (Irene + Karthik) by EOD 6/16, 2) patch PRs for critical issues (security groups, helm exposure) by 6/18, 3) CI gating job change + smoke run (Marissa) by 6/22.

I created a Jira INFRA-2217 to track the action items and added a temporary CI job (link below) for smoke validation.

Related links:
- Jenkins gate: https://ci.redwood.com/job/priv-deploy-gate/356
- Jira: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INFRA-2217
- Drive note: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-iac-review

Can Karthik and Irene call out what you need from ACME to move quickly? If ACME can scope which modules contain the open SGs and the helm charts that enabled admin endpoints that will speed us up.

Thanks,
Sofia
Product Security / Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Katie Mullins <katie@acme-corp.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deploy - quick conformance scan and network notes

Folks — did a first-pass technical triage of the PDF and a couple of the JSON artifacts from the zip. Notes and suggested remediations below:

1) Network anti-patterns seen:
   - Wide egress/ingress (0.0.0.0/0) on older module acme-common/security-groups: these are legacy rules opened for outbound telemetry. Replace with specific telemetry endpoints and add an egress proxy in private subnets.
   - Public LBs with admin endpoints: set annotations to internal-only (for AWS alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme) and switch admin endpoints to clusterIP + internal LB.

2) Terraform/Module hygiene:
   - Add a versions.tf with required_providers + required_version >= 1.4.0; enable dependency lock (.terraform.lock.hcl) in CI.
   - Replace inline provider sources with pinned module versions (registry ref or git tag).

3) CI/CD and gating:
   - Add tflint + checkov stages; use checkov baseline to allow acceptable exceptions but fail on critical.
   - Publish terraform plans as artifacts and run plan-diff against a production-like state using a dry-run sandbox account.

4) Ansible/Secrets:
   - Remove generated keys from repo. Use Ansible lookup for secrets from KMS/Secrets Manager. Add an ansible-lint step.

5) On-prem specifics (if ACME will air-gap):
   - Ensure node MTU and overlay settings are consistent across racks (Calico default), check for IP overlap between customer VLANs and Redwood-managed control ranges.
   - If BGP is used for on-prem routing, validate community tagging and route filters in the terraform modules for metal gateways.

Actionables for ACME: please point us at the module path(s) that open the SGs (example: modules/security-group/main.tf) and the helm chart/path for the admin exposed service. If you can produce a minimal repro plan (terraform plan -out=prod.tfplan) we can run the same tflint/checkov scan locally.

I've attached a lightweight terraform plan sample (terraform-plan-prod.tfplan) and a recommended helm override (helm-values-overrides.yaml) for reference.

-Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Team — short meeting summary and confirmed owners. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Summary:
- Triage completed: critical = open SGs (acme-common/security-groups), public admin LB exposure; major = unpinned modules + secrets in repo; minor = lint findings and doc gaps.

Owners & deadlines:
- Karthik: close SG open rules and provide PR to modules/security-group by 2026-06-18 (done)
- Irene: helm values override and chart hardening PR by 2026-06-22
- Sofia: CI gating changes (tflint/checkov job + plan artifacts) by 2026-06-22
- ACME (Katie): confirm module paths and share a minimal prod.tfplan by 2026-06-16 (received)

Notes:
- We will gate ACME’s Private onboarding behind the CI gating and at least one successful dry-run in our staging sandbox. If ACME needs accelerated help, we can offer a 2-day SOC-supported remediation engagement (quote separate).
- Follow-up doc with exact PR references and checkov baseline will be uploaded to the Drive link.

Attachments: terraform-plan-prod.tfplan, helm-values-overrides.yaml

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Lead, Redwood Inference
